input.reason: "Easier to read" could mean several different changes. Every one of them changes the list format that the tests in format.test.ts and commands.test.ts currently pin down ("[ ] milk", "[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). I'd rather not guess which tested behaviour you want changed.
input.question:
Which change(s) do you want in the `list` output? Right now each line is just `[ ] milk` / `[x] eggs`. Options:
1. Show the id on each line so you know what to pass to `complete`, e.g. `#1 [ ] milk`.
2. Show the due date, which is stored but never displayed, e.g. `[ ] milk (due 2026-11-01)`.
3. Line up the columns (pad the ids and titles so due dates sit in a column).
4. Put open items before done ones, or add a summary line like `2 open, 1 done`.
5. Colour or dim done items with ANSI codes. This one makes the plain-text output messier when piped.
6. Something else, maybe for the `Added #1` / `Completed #1` messages.
If you're fine with my suggestion: 1 + 2, giving `#1 [ ] milk (due 2026-11-01)`, with the due part left off when there's no date. I'd update the tests to match.
